Mozilla's CA certificate list, as converted to PEM by the curl project
=====================================================================

File:      cacert.pem (unmodified)
Source:    https://curl.se/ca/cacert.pem
Data:      "Certificate data from Mozilla as of: Thu Nov  5 04:12:01 2026 GMT"
           (see the "##" header at the top of cacert.pem)
SHA-256:   427c064216761a1e72a8b30f0d954d08cb6e4435a82091fb865afd20c8497285
           (checked against the publisher's https://curl.se/ca/cacert.pem.sha256)
Contents:  118 root certificates (all usable by BearSSL: RSA and P-256 / P-384 keys)
License:   Mozilla Public License 2.0 (MPL-2.0.txt in this directory). The
           certificate data come from Mozilla's certdata.txt (NSS).

Use: tools/mktrust.py converts it at build time into BearSSL trust anchors
(build/user/web/trust.c, linked into libweb), keeping the bundle's "##"
header as a comment. tests/web/tatest.c checks the conversion against
BearSSL's own decoders.

To update: download cacert.pem and cacert.pem.sha256 into an empty
directory, check the hash, replace the file here, update this file, run
tests/web/run.sh.
